SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date) s, max(calendar_date) e, count(*) n, sum(is_trading_day::int) trading
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 5 AS first_week, 8 AS last_week
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND params.last_week
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
CROSS JOIN params
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, sum(r.net_sales) AS control_net_sales, sum(r.receipts) rec
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, f.sale_date, f.etl_loaded_at
 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
),
d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c FROM x GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1),
d2 AS (SELECT sales_line_id, count(*) c FROM x GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM x) total_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM d) dup_receipt_line, (SELECT count(*) FROM d2) dup_line_id,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) ret_rows, (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) ret_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_return_line r2 ON r.sales_line_id=r2.sales_line_id AND r.return_line_id<r2.return_line_id) ret_dup_sl

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, 
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS test_net,
 sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_sale_date_net,
 count(DISTINCT s.store_id) stores
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.channel_code, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH d AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT dd.fiscal_year, dd.fiscal_period, count(*) dup_rows, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_date dd ON dd.calendar_date=f.sale_date GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'closure' k, c.store_id, s.store_name, CAST(c.closure_type AS VARCHAR) t, c.closure_start_date a, c.closure_end_date b, c.weeks_closed w
FROM ref_store_closure c JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id=c.store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE c.closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND c.closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store', store_id, store_name, format, open_date, close_date, NULL FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current AND (close_date IS NOT NULL OR open_date >= DATE '2024-05-01')
ORDER BY 1,5
